config.name: autonomous_control_10000
config.particle_policy: fixed per trajectory; independent of sampled real episode
config.memory_timing: write real prefix strictly before target; candidate scoring read-only
config.feedback: generated writes with full BPTT; writer weights frozen in G updates
config.loss_normalization: weighted mean of active adversarial losses and penalties
config.penalty_domain: handoff: candidate; cold: full path; warm: generated suffix with real prefix fixed
